revision: S2/P3: schematic S2 (gain x20, signal nets wired); placement P3 = THT only. P3 (user review 2026-10-28): IN jack on top (as audio-out), then LEVEL L / LEVEL R (21.5 mm pitch), OUT L / OUT R / MONO at the bottom (14 mm pitch), power header horizontal along the bottom edge. SMD parts are parked off the board edge for group-by-group placement; nothing is routed.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: As modules/audio-out (4HP): single hole pair at X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right, as modules/midi); skiff rails leave the clear Y8.0..120.5 gap.

main_pcb.note: 19.0 x 110.0 mm as modules/audio-out, 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end; held by the four jack bushings/nuts (the RV09 pots take no nut). 2 layers like audio-out; SMD on B.

column_note: Jacks and pots share one centred column at X10.0 (the panel centre line). Top to bottom (P3, user 2026-10-28: IN on top, knobs next, outputs as low as possible): IN, LEVEL L, LEVEL R, OUT L, OUT R, MONO.
jack_rotation_note: As modules/midi: T/TN(R)/S pads run along X with the S (sleeve) pad toward the left board edge (T at X+4.92, TN/R at X-3.38, S at X-6.48); jack bodies are 9.0 mm along Y.

jacks.role: IN (stereo TRS: tip L, ring R)

jack_note: P3: IN (J1) on top at Y19.0 (audio-out IN L at Y19.5); OUT L / OUT R / MONO at the bottom on a 14 mm pitch, MONO as low as the horizontal J10 allows (J4 courtyard bottom Y111.29, J10 courtyard top Y111.61; J4 pads end Y108.05, 2.2 mm above the IDC10 socket envelope). The carrier hangs on the four jack nuts (the RV09 pots take no nut): one at the top, three in the lower half.
pot_part: RV09 50k linear (user stock: no threaded bushing, no nut, 16 mm knurled shaft), Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint
pot_note: Footprint origin is offset (+0.127, +0.508) from the shaft centre (audio-out). Rotation 0: tabs at shaft Y, pins 1-2-3 (GND, wiper, CW = jack) 7.5 mm below the shaft; courtyard shaft-5.12..shaft+8.67. P3: 21.5 mm pot pitch; the free height between IN and OUT L is split evenly: courtyard gaps IN-RV1 7.1, RV1-RV2 7.7, RV2-OUT L 7.05 mm.
panel_hole_note: Pot hole 7.2 mm = Bread Modular PanelHole_Potentiometer_RV09. The user's pot has no threaded bushing (plain Ø6 knurled shaft), so the hole is shaft clearance only.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.source: Jacks: slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks. Pot: user sample (2026-10-19 photo, B1M RV09 'tall trimmer' style): no threaded bushing, 16 mm knurled shaft above the body (user measurement); body height nominal.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: RV09 proxy (tools/make_pot_model.py): body 6.8 mm (nominal), 1 mm collar, shaft to Z22.8 = 11.2 mm past the FR4 front (10.8 mm past the printed front) for a push-on knob. No bushing, so no pot nut: the carrier hangs on the four jack nuts only (as before).

power_header.orientation: Horizontal along the bottom edge (user direction 2026-10-28; as modules/hats and modules/vca-mix), rot 270 on B: odd pins on the upper row Y113.4, even pins on Y115.94; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the left, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the right. Courtyard Y111.61..117.73 (1 mm edge keep-out: board edge Y119.25).
power_header.idc_note: 10-pin cable only (as audio-out: 10-to-16 cable on a 16-pin bus): a 16-pin socket would overhang the 4HP width. Envelope = 2x5 IDC socket (3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres along X, 6.4 mm body + 1.2 mm key bump on either side along Y): on the board (X0.5..19.5, Y..119.25) and clear of every THT pad (J4 pads end Y108.05). Unshrouded, so nothing keys it: red stripe (-12 V) to the left, marked on B silk. B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall. D1/D2 and the bulk caps go in the band between MONO and J10 or beside the jacks when the power group is placed.

back_side_tht.note: bottom edge, horizontal, as modules/hats J10 (rot 270 on B)

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the right board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer). DRC reports them as outside the board until then.

panel_label_note: P3: labels centred on the column above each part (8.9 mm above a pot shaft, 6.4 mm above a jack, IN 6.2 mm as audio-out). Knobs up to ~15 mm clear the labels (repo practice: Thonk Tall Trimmer Toppers 7.8 mm, imix; audio-out 19 mm pitch rated ~15 mm; 8bit 15 mm pitch ~11 mm; 4mix big knob 18 mm reserve). 4HP width (20 mm) is the real limit: keep knobs <= ~15 mm.
